title: Mass Effect Trilogy: $8.99 vs Your $12 Movie
caption:
Mass Effect Legendary Edition (all 3 games, remastered) is $8.99 on Steam right now, 85% off $59.99. The three main stories take about 68 hours, so that's about 13¢ an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Trilogy or one movie night: which would you take?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 28 Nov), HowLongToBeat, SVG
ig_first_line: Send this to your friend who still hasn't played Mass Effect: 3 games, $8.99, about 68 hours.
